# Countdown API

Countdown API provides real-time eBay product data, including product details, customer reviews, seller feedback, and search results, enabling businesses and developers to access comprehensive eBay marketplace information.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/countdown-api/.

## Actions

- **Clear Collection Requests**: Clear all requests from a specified collection.
- **Create Destination**: Create a destination.
- **Delete Collection**: Delete a collection and its configuration by ID.
- **Delete Destination**: Delete a destination by ID.
- **Delete Single Request**: Remove a specific request from a collection.
- **eBay Autocomplete** (read-only): Fetch eBay autocomplete suggestions.
- **Export Requests as JSON** (read-only): Download all requests in a collection as JSON.
- **Export Requests CSV** (read-only): Export all requests in a collection as CSV download links.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve account usage and current platform status.
- **Get Collection** (read-only): Retrieve details for a single collection by ID.
- **Get Result Set** (read-only): Retrieve a collection run's result set payload.
- **List Collections** (read-only): List all collections for the authenticated account.
- **List Destinations** (read-only): List all destinations configured for the account.
- **List Requests Paged** (read-only): List requests for a collection by page.
- **List Result Sets** (read-only): List result sets produced by a collection.
- **Resend Result Set Webhook**: Resend the webhook for a previously generated result set.
- **Start Collection**: Start processing a collection's queued requests.
- **Stop All Collections**: Stop all collections.
- **Stop Collection**: Stop (pause) a single collection’s processing by ID.
- **Update an existing collection**: Update an existing collection.
- **Update Destination**: Update a destination's configuration by ID.
- **Update Single Request**: Modify parameters of an existing request in a collection.
- **Create a new collection**: Create a new collection.
